title: Beef Shanks Gravy
description: A hearty and flavorful beef shanks dish cooked with vegetables and spices, served with rice or potatoes.

ingredients.item: Beef shanks, seasoned with desired seasonings
Can of hot Rotel diced fire roasted tomatoes
Optional: rice or potatoes for serving

steps: Heat a pan over medium-high heat and add lard.
Season the beef shanks with desired seasonings and dredge in all-purpose flour.
Sear the beef shanks until browned on all sides, then set aside.
In the same pan, add chopped bell pepper, green onions, carrots, onions, and celery; cook until vegetables are tender.
Scrape the bottom of the pan to loosen browned bits.
Add the can of Rotel diced fire roasted tomatoes to the pan.
Season with onion powder, garlic powder, cayenne pepper, cumin, and thyme.
Pour in four cups of beef broth.
Return the seared beef shanks to the pan, add jalapeno juice and sliced jalapenos.
Cover and transfer the pan to a preheated oven at 350°F (175°C).
Cook for three hours until the beef is fork tender and the bone marrow is in the sauce.
Serve hot with rice or potatoes.
